races.paceDynamic: Master Haku and The Store Boy will set a moderate early pace with their prominent styles, while 17 runners create a large field dynamic where positioning becomes crucial. The early gallop should be sustainable given the limited pace pressure, but the large field means traffic problems are inevitable in the straight. With most runners adopting hold-up tactics and needing to make ground from the back, the race will become a cavalry charge from the home turn. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can avoid trouble and position close to the pace throughout.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Master Haku and The Store Boy avoid jumping errors and maintain their forward positions
scenarios.body: The clean jumping and tactical positioning of the front two proves decisive as the field gets into trouble behind. Their prominent styles allow them to dictate terms and kick for home when the pack is still organising.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates significant traffic problems for the leaders
scenarios.body: A patient hold-up performer finds the perfect route through while the prominent pair get swamped by the field. The strong pace collapse allows a late finisher to capitalise on superior class.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the debutants shows natural jumping ability and settles kindly
scenarios.body: A well-bred newcomer like Cullagh Lad or Lamikal d'Airy benefits from the race experience and shows untapped ability. Their fresh legs prove decisive in the closing stages against more exposed rivals.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders fold completely and create a messy tactical affair
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace becomes a crawl before a mad dash, suiting nothing in particular and creating an open finish. Form goes out the window as jumping and luck determine the outcome.

races.paceDynamic: Jazz Forever is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 17-runner field and should get an easy lead with the prominent runners Lady Doyanne, Must Meet Cecil, Jury Belle, Desert Haven and Chanceawetmorning unlikely to pressure him early. The large field will bunch up behind the moderate early gallop, setting up a cavalry charge from the final hurdle. This sustainable pace heavily favours the hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, with the 10 hold-up specialists getting ideal conditions to unleash their finishing speed when it matters most.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Jazz Forever sets his usual steady gallop and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: The patient riders can time their challenges perfectly from off the pace. Kabylia, Spinning Web, Jerrari and Malbas all have proven course form and tactical speed to exploit this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent duo strike
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Doyanne or Must Meet Cecil press Jazz Forever into a stronger gallop
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and gives the prominent runners first run on the leaders. Lady Doyanne's De Bromhead polish or Must Meet Cecil's experience could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Jazz Forever goes too slowly and nobody takes him on until very late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last and pure class tells over tactics. Survivors Sister's high RPR of 121 and Jerrari's recent course win become crucial factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Jazz Forever stays on
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runner finds his finishing kick for once and the field comes too late
scenarios.body: His early advantage proves insurmountable despite his usual fading tendency. The patient hold-up horses leave their runs too late to catch him.

races.paceDynamic: Krishna Bellevue will likely take up the running with Mon Sheriffe for company, creating a sustainable pace given both are natural front runners without excessive early speed. The large field of 19 runners will string out behind them, with most runners adopting hold-up tactics including proven performers like Pourquoi Poi and The Toothpicker. The moderate early gallop will set up a cavalry charge from the back, as the majority of the field relies on finishing kicks rather than sustained pressure from the front. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late acceleration, as they'll have every chance to get into contention from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Krishna Bellevue and Mon Sheriffe set a steady pace without being pressured early
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows the large pack of hold-up horses to stay in touch and unleash finishing kicks in the straight. Proven campaigners with tactical speed like Pourquoi Poi and The Toothpicker can pick off the leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runners steal march
scenarios.trigger: If Mon Sheriffe or Krishna Bellevue kick clear approaching the final flight while others are still getting organized
scenarios.body: The early leaders gain crucial lengths while the hold-up brigade are caught flat-footed, making their task from behind insurmountable. The winner comes from those who raced handily throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Veteran experience prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a messy affair with fallers or interference affecting the fancied runners
scenarios.body: Experience and jumping accuracy become paramount, allowing seasoned campaigners who can avoid trouble to pick up the pieces. Older horses like Dontdooddson thrive in chaotic scenarios.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapse benefits
scenarios.trigger: If both Krishna Bellevue and Mon Sheriffe fade dramatically in the closing stages as expected
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the final hurdle with no clear pace advantage, allowing any horse with a turn of foot to capitalize regardless of earlier position. Lesser fancied runners can emerge from the pack.

scenarios.body: These prominent/mid-division types get the best of both worlds - close enough to track Pray Tell's moves but not committed to making the running themselves. Their tactical positioning proves optimal when the field closes up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Pray Tell stops suddenly or makes jumping errors, leaving a leadership vacuum in the final mile
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair where the best jumper rather than the classiest horse prevails, potentially opening the door for an outsider. Give Him A Chance's recent course form over hurdles could prove valuable in a scrambled finish.

races.paceDynamic: Hitthehayson, Tell Nobody Nothin, Doyen Magic and Marelly will set a strong gallop from the start, with multiple confirmed front-runners ensuring no let-up in pace. The sustained gallop over 2m4f on good to yielding ground will test stamina reserves, particularly with 17 runners creating additional pressure through the early stages. Prominent racers and those with proven stamina will benefit from tracking the pace-setters, while hold-up horses face a tactical disadvantage as the strong gallop will stretch the field and reduce their room for manoeuvre. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those who can sit handy early before staying on strongly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Suits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Hitthehayson and Tell Nobody Nothin maintain a relentless gallop from flag-fall
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will find out the stamina-shy runners and set up perfectly for those tracking in behind with proven staying power. Favori Logique and Stoneyford Lady can sit prominent and use their class advantage when the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Hitthehayson gets an uncontested lead and controls the tempo
scenarios.body: The winner can dictate fractions and kick clear when others are still organising their challenges, using superior fitness from recent Haydock victory. Strong pace still benefits those who can track the winner throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge From Back
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses mid-race allowing hold-up horses time to organise
scenarios.body: Jack Kennedy can produce Iamagetaway with a trademark late run, while Duffys Hodey's proven finishing kick becomes decisive. The lack of early pace allows stamina to become less relevant.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or incidents disrupt the pace and remove key contenders
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where an unfancied runner like Good World or Sampoet can benefit from a clear passage and reduced competition. Form becomes less relevant as tactical positioning trumps class.
